done_when: tests/test_proto_deploy.py labels every container and network it creates, and before it starts it removes labelled ones older than an hour, so a killed run's leftovers never pile up; its existing cleanup on a normal finish stays. A test proves an old labelled leftover is removed and a fresh one (another run still going) is kept.
why: The prototype deploy test leaves its Docker containers and networks behind whenever its run is killed (a timeout or a stopped worker), and on a busy machine they fill Docker's address pool, so later test runs fail creating a network
